verdicts.why: Row glosses 'જેટલું જલ્દી' as 'as quickly as', which is part of its own LEGO (as soon as I can) but the seed says 'as soon as I can', so it is a literal gloss, not an orphan.
'do not worry' is the uncontracted form of the seed's "don't worry", so it is the same words with a contraction difference and is not a stray.
'various different' glosses અલગ-અલગ, but the seed renders it only as 'different'; the row belongs to this sentence.
Row matches the LEGO's 'what I need to do' content, but the seed has 'I need to do' and the row says "I've got to do"; it is a paraphrase of its own chunk.
'is' is the second half of the LEGO 'મારે છે => I've got', and the seed's "I've got" fuses it, so the row is clitic-fused and not an orphan.
'whom' is a relative pronoun that the seed 'people I don't know' leaves out; it is a back-gloss of a dropped word.
'well' is the positive form while the seed has 'better'; it is a different form of the same word.
The row says "what's going to happen" but the seed has 'what was going to happen'; this is a tense difference, not an orphan.
'very little time' glosses ઘણો ઓછો સમય, while the seed renders it as 'much time' inside a negative; the row belongs to this sentence.
'before' is the literal gloss of પહેલાં; the seed renders it as 'ago'.
'in a city' is the literal gloss of શહેરમાં, while the seed says 'to the city'.
'that' is the literal gloss of the particle તો, which the seed 'It's the least I could do' does not render.
'not' is the negation fused into the seed's "won't", so it is not a contiguous substring.
'not' belongs to 'will never' in the seed, where negation is fused into 'never'.
'to me' glosses મને, which the seed renders inside "I'm afraid".
'is' is fused into the seed's "It's".
'you understand' glosses તમે સમજો, while the seed says 'you know what I mean'; the row belongs to this sentence.
'in giving' is a literal gloss of આપવામાં; the seed renders it as 'to answer'.
'seems' glosses લાગે છે, which the seed renders as "I'm finding it hard"; the row belongs to this sentence.
'am tired' is not contiguous in the seed, which reads "I'm too tired" with 'too' interposed and 'am' contracted.
